prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency for every company — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the channels you need (SEO, PPC, social, content, creative, analytics, growth engineering, etc.). I can help find the best fit for you — but first I need a few details.

Quick questions
- What are your top goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, app installs, fundraising, etc.)
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram, LinkedIn, content, email, CRO, analytics)
- Monthly budget range for agency services/ad spend?
- Company type/industry and target geographies
- Timeline (immediate campaign vs. long-term growth)
- Do you need an agency that will also do creative/production, or only media/strategy?

How to pick the best agency (criteria)
- Relevant experience: proven work in your industry and channel(s)
- Measurable results: case studies and KPIs (ROAS, CPA, MQLs, conversions)
- Transparency & reporting: clear dashboards, access to data, attribution model
- Team & communication: named team members, availability, length of engagement
- Tools & partnerships: Google/Facebook/Microsoft partner badges, analytics stack
- Pricing & contract flexibility: month-to-month vs long-term, scope clarity
- References and retention: existing client references and churn rate

Where to find and compare agencies
- Clutch.co and G2 for verified reviews and filters by location/service
- Google Partners and Facebook Marketing Partners directories
- LinkedIn searches and recommendations in San Francisco groups
- Local referrals from peers, meetups, or industry events

Questions to ask agencies in your shortlist
- Have you worked with companies like ours? Can you show results?
- What would success look like in 3, 6, and 12 months?
- Who will be our day-to-day contact, and who does the work?
- What tools/platforms do you use and what access will we have?
- How do you measure and report ROI (reporting cadence and metrics)?
- What is your typical onboarding process and timeline?
- Can you provide two client references we can call?

If you want, tell me the answers to the quick questions above and I’ll:
- Recommend 3–5 San Francisco agencies that match your needs (with strengths, estimated cost range, and questions to ask each), or
- Draft an RFP template you can send to agencies to get comparable proposals.
